purpose: Binding preserves native warning priority and count/type traces before initialization. Named bindTo keeps original and replacement targets distinct; a chained copy survives its source copy and source Generator retirement. The retargeted copy also enters the existing explicit __invoke wrapper.
source:
<?php
class Scope114A {}
function flow114A($name) {
    try { echo 'INIT|', $name, '|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $name, '|', $value, '|'; yield 'tail'; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|', $name, '|'; }
}
$old = flow114A('old'); $new = flow114A('new'); $capture = $old->send(...);
set_error_handler(function($level, $message) { echo 'WARN|', $level, '|', $message, '|'; return true; });
echo 'NULL|', $capture->bindTo(null) === null, '|';
echo 'OBJECT|', $capture->bindTo(new stdClass()) === null, '|';
echo 'UNSCOPED|', $capture->bindTo($new, null) === null, '|';
echo 'INTERNAL|', $capture->bindTo($new, 'stdClass') === null, '|';
echo 'SCOPE|', $capture->bindTo($new, 'Scope114A') === null, '|';
echo 'MISSING|', $capture->bindTo($new, 'Missing114A') === null, '|';
restore_error_handler();
try { $capture->bindTo(); } catch (ArgumentCountError $e) { $t = $e->getTrace(); echo 'COUNT|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $t[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $t[0]['function'] === 'bindTo', '|', !isset($t[1]), '|'; }
try { $capture->bindTo(17); } catch (TypeError $e) { $t = $e->getTrace(); echo 'THIS|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $t[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $t[0]['function'] === 'bindTo', '|', !isset($t[1]), '|'; }
try { $capture->bindTo($new, []); } catch (TypeError $e) { $t = $e->getTrace(); echo 'TYPE-SCOPE|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $t[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $t[0]['function'] === 'bindTo', '|', !isset($t[1]), '|'; }
unset($e, $t);
$bound = $capture->bindTo(newThis: $new, newScope: 'Generator');
echo 'BOUND|', $bound->__invoke(value: 41), '|';
echo 'ORIGINAL|', $capture(9), '|';
$chained = $bound->bindTo($old); unset($bound, $new);
echo 'CHAIN|', $chained(13), '|';
unset($chained, $capture, $old); echo 'DONE|';

purpose: A binding warning callback clears original capture and both Generator CVs, while native argv/receiver owners keep all alive. Supplied Stop aborts before allocation; replacement argument finally precedes original-capture release, with exact weak visibility and exception identity.

<?php
class Stop114T extends Exception {}
function old114T() {
    try { echo 'OLD-INIT|'; yield 'old'; }
    finally { global $weakOld, $weakCapture; echo 'OLD-FIN|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function new114T() {
    try { echo 'NEW-INIT|'; yield 'new'; }
    finally { global $weakOld, $weakCapture, $weakNew; echo 'NEW-FIN|', $weakNew->get() !== null, '|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() !== null, '|'; }
}
$old = old114T(); $old->current(); $replacement = new114T(); $replacement->current();
$capture = $old->send(...); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old); $weakNew = WeakReference::create($replacement); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $stop = new Stop114T('given');
set_error_handler(function($level, $message) {
    global $old, $replacement, $capture, $weakOld, $weakNew, $weakCapture, $stop;
    echo 'WARN|', $level, '|', $message, '|'; $old = null; $replacement = null; $capture = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakNew->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() !== null, '|';
    throw $stop;
});
try { echo 'BIND|'; $bound = $capture->bindTo($replacement, 'stdClass'); echo 'BAD|'; }
catch (Stop114T $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakNew->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|', !isset($bound), '|'; }
restore_error_handler(); echo 'DONE|';

purpose: An ignored binding copy must release its replacement Generator before releasing the original bindTo receiver. A scope callback clears both CVs; new finally still sees original capture/Gen live, followed by old finally after capture weak notification.

<?php
function old114U() {
    try { echo 'OLD-INIT|'; yield 'old'; }
    finally { global $weakOld, $weakCapture; echo 'OLD-FIN|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function replacement114U() {
    try { echo 'NEW-INIT|'; yield 'new'; }
    finally { global $weakNew, $weakOld, $weakCapture; echo 'NEW-FIN|', $weakNew->get() !== null, '|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() !== null, '|'; }
}
function scope114U() {
    global $capture, $replacement, $weakOld, $weakNew, $weakCapture;
    echo 'SCOPE|'; $capture = null; $replacement = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $weakOld->get() !== null, '|', $weakNew->get() !== null, '|', $weakCapture->get() !== null, '|';
    return 'static';
}
$old = old114U(); $old->current(); $replacement = replacement114U(); $replacement->current();
$capture = $old->send(...); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old); $weakNew = WeakReference::create($replacement); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $old = null;
echo 'BIND|'; $capture->bindTo($replacement, scope114U());
echo 'AFTER|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakNew->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|DONE|';
